form.name: Habit Name
form.anti_habit_description: Mark as a bad habit you want to reduce or avoid (e.g., Smoking, Junk Food).
form.delete_body: This will permanently delete this habit and all its tracked data. This action cannot be undone.
type.count.label: Count
type.count.description: Track daily counts (e.g., glasses of water, pages read).
type.check.label: Check
type.check.description: Simple yes/no daily completion (e.g., meditated, journaled).
type.timed.label: Timed
type.timed.description: Track duration or time spent (e.g., 30 min reading).
type.complex.label: Structured Session
type.complex.description: Log sets, reps, weights, time, or distance (e.g., Gym).
list.empty: No habits yet — add one above
list.drop_here_habits: Drop here to add to Habits
list.drop_here_anti: Drop here to mark as anti-habit
list.drag_to_anti: Drag a habit here to mark it as an anti-habit
list.error.anti_restriction: Only Count, Check, and Timed habits can be marked as anti-habits.
